notes: All names, IDs and traces are fictional. Unless an eval says otherwise, the workspace contains no checkout of the owning repo and no crash backend is connected, so these evals exercise parsing, analysis, ACTION routing and the exit contract without touching a real git host. Grade each assertion against the console output and the final run-result JSON block.

evals.name: pasted-npe-natural-language-fix
evals.prompt:
Fix this crash from the shop app:

FATAL EXCEPTION: main
Process: com.example.shop, PID: 4242
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'java.math.BigDecimal com.example.shop.orders.model.Cart.getTotal()' on a null object reference
	at com.example.shop.orders.CartViewModel$applyCoupon$1.invokeSuspend(CartViewModel.kt:118)
	at kotlin.coroutines.jvm.internal.BaseContinuationImpl.resumeWith(ContinuationImpl.kt:33)
	at kotlinx.coroutines.DispatchedTask.run(DispatchedTask.kt:108)
	at android.os.Handler.handleCallback(Handler.java:942)
	at android.os.Looper.loop(Looper.java:288)
	at android.app.ActivityThread.main(ActivityThread.java:7918)
evals.expected_output: The pasted trace is taken as MANUAL_ISSUE_TEXT (Mode C) with ACTION=FIX inferred from 'fix'. The root location is the first-party coroutine frame, normalised to CartViewModel / applyCoupon, classified C4 with origin APP. The owning repo is not on disk, so the run warns and stops at analysis rather than failing.
assertions: Logs an AUTO line inferring MANUAL_ISSUE_TEXT from the message; no FATAL for a missing selector
Logs action=FIX chosen by the verb rule (rule 3)
Strips the frame class from the first '$' and reports the enclosing method applyCoupon
Feature slug matches crash-fix-cartviewmodel-manual-<8 hex>
Emits the 'Module for … not found' WARN and the Step 7 'stopping at analysis' WARN, not a FATAL
No branch is created, nothing is pushed, pull_requests is []
Run result JSON is the last fenced block and has every top-level key, with fatal null

evals.name: anr-lock-holder
evals.prompt:
Investigate this ANR dump:

"main" prio=5 tid=1 Blocked
  | group="main" sCount=1 ucsCount=0 flags=1 obj=0x72a1 self=0xb400
  at com.example.shop.catalogue.FeedCache.snapshot(FeedCache.kt:41)
  - waiting to lock <0x0a1b> (a com.example.shop.catalogue.FeedCache) held by thread 23
  at com.example.shop.catalogue.HomeFeedViewModel.load(HomeFeedViewModel.kt:57)
  at com.example.shop.catalogue.HomeFeedFragment.onViewCreated(HomeFeedFragment.kt:33)
  at android.os.Looper.loop(Looper.java:288)

"feed-sync-2" prio=5 tid=23 Native
  at java.io.FileInputStream.read(FileInputStream.java:276)
  at com.example.shop.catalogue.FeedCache.readFromDisk(FeedCache.kt:102)
  at com.example.shop.catalogue.FeedCache.refresh(FeedCache.kt:88)
  - locked <0x0a1b> (a com.example.shop.catalogue.FeedCache)
  at com.example.shop.catalogue.FeedSyncWorker.doWork(FeedSyncWorker.kt:29)
evals.expected_output: ISSUE_TYPE=ANR is inferred, ACTION=ANALYSE from 'investigate'. The main thread waits on 0x0a1b, the lock holder is feed-sync-2 inside FeedCache.refresh doing disk I/O, so the root location is the holder's frame and the class is C6-LOCK.
assertions: Logs inferred ISSUE_TYPE=ANR and action=ANALYSE (rule 4)
Names feed-sync-2 as the lock holder and FeedCache.refresh as the root location, not FeedCache.snapshot
Hypothesis says the monitor is held across a disk read
TC-001 in test_cases.json uses a test dispatcher or bounded wait and states a threading assertion the unfixed code fails
No branch, push, or PR is created

evals.name: action-analyse-top-anr-by-app-name
evals.prompt: Look at the top ANR for the shop app
evals.setup: APP_REGISTRY maps SHOP to 'Example Shop - Android'. A fake crash backend returns one top ANR whose sample is a main thread doing SharedPreferences commit() from com.example.shop.app.StartupInitializer.onCreate. The example-shop-app repo is checked out but on a stale local branch with an uncommitted change.
evals.expected_output: APP=SHOP and ISSUE_TYPE=ANR are inferred, ACTION=ANALYSE. The run classifies C6-IO, reads the chain from origin/{DEFAULT_BRANCH} without switching branches, and stops after Step 6.
assertions: Logs inferred APP=SHOP and ISSUE_TYPE=ANR from the message
Never runs git checkout, git checkout -B, git commit, git push, or a PR-create command
Leaves the developer's branch and uncommitted change untouched; emits the 'checkout is not a clean origin/{DEFAULT_BRANCH}' WARN
Analysis document, sprint_plan.json and test_cases.json are written
Summary says no changes were made and to re-run with ACTION=FIX

evals.name: idempotent-rerun
evals.setup: CI=true. Same fake backend issue as references/worked_example.md. On the git host: branch {FIX_BRANCH_PREFIX}anr-fix-feedcache-7d20b8e4a6c1 exists in catalogue-lib, the catalogue repo and orders-lib, each head commit ending in 'Issue: 7d20b8e4a6c1'; the catalogue branch has 'chore: bump catalogue-lib to 3.2.8' and 'chore: bump orders-lib to 2.9.5'; the tracker reads catalogue-lib 3.2.8 and orders-lib 2.9.5; open PRs exist for catalogue-lib and the catalogue repo, none for orders-lib or example-shop-app. A stale local branch of the same name exists in the catalogue-lib checkout.
evals.expected_output: The run redoes the analysis, resumes every existing branch, reuses both versions without touching the tracker, reuses the two open PRs, and raises only the missing ones.
assertions: Logs action=FIX (rule 2) because CI is set
Uses git checkout -B "$BR" "origin/$BR" for each existing branch; never a bare git checkout -b, and the stale local branch causes no error
No branch name contains a '{git_user}/' segment
No new commit on {VERSION_TRACKER_BRANCH}; the tracker still reads 3.2.8 and 2.9.5
Logs 'already bumped to 3.2.8 on this fix branch — reusing' for catalogue-lib
pull_requests marks catalogue-lib and the catalogue repo as reused_existing true, and has exactly one entry per repo
Every new commit ends with the line 'Issue: 7d20b8e4a6c1'
